Employment Opportunities

## Careers Overview

**All of our current vacancies are posted on the StateJobsNY website:**

[StateJobsNY](https://statejobs.ny.gov/public/vacancyTable.cfm?searchResults=Yes&Keywords=&title=&JurisClassID=&AgID=12&minDate=&maxDate=&employmentType=&grade=&SalMin=)

At the NYS Office of Information Technology Services (ITS), we create and deliver innovative solutions that foster a technology-enabled government.

ITS is home to approximately 4,000 professionals who handle the delivery of information technology services to over 50 partner agencies. Our services include innovative mobile app development, the design and creation of fully responsive websites, cyber security, and development and support for mission critical applications.

Our engineers, programmers, architects, and designers collaborate to innovate NYS systems. We work as one connected community of technology professionals- providing opportunities for our employees to build new skills, achieve a higher degree of mastery, and strive for innovative solutions that anticipate our partners' needs, extending into "foreseeable future."We believe our employees are our most important asset and seek creative, motivated individuals to bring depth and knowledge to our team.

ITS offers both technical and non-technical career opportunities, some of which are open to the public.

Learn more about ITS and how you can secure your future while building, strengthening, and transforming New York.

## Entry Level IT Positions

**The NYS Office of Information Technology Services (ITS) Entry Level Opportunities**

Our core title series is titled Information Technology Specialist and has a significant career ladder, with two entry level points, for which we are continuously recruiting:

*   Information Technology Specialist 1 (general and Programming), SG14: Starting salary currently: $53,764.
*   Information Technology Specialist 2 (general and Programming), SG18: Starting salary currently:$66,951.

For additional information, including minimum qualification, and to apply please visit [StateJobsNY](https://statejobs.ny.gov/public/vacancyTable.cfm?searchResults=Yes&Keywords=&title=&JurisClassID=&AgID=12&minDate=&maxDate=&employmentType=&grade=&SalMin=).

* * *

## Executive Positions

ITS has career opportunities at all levels of leadership, including at the executive level. These positions include the Deputy Commissioners for Technology (DCTs).

The DCTs are working hand-in-hand with agency leaders, resolving issues before they become problems, making informed decisions about how and when to leverage technology, and helping to fuel the State’s ongoing digital transformation. The DCT is a senior-level ITS executive embedded within a single agency or several similar agencies. This organizational approach combines subject matter experts with high-level tech support. These leaders are backed up by both dedicated and shared services teams in support of client agencies, aligned with the State’s overall technology vision.

### **Key Responsibilities of DCTs**

*   Assist ITS executive staff in IT service planning and execution.
*   Participate in IT governance and investment decisions.
*   Oversee IT projects, ensuring alignment with agency needs.
*   Develop and implement communication strategies with stakeholders.
*   Lead IT service escalations to ensure quality service delivery.
*   Coordinate IT resource allocation and strategic planning.
*   Identify opportunities for IT service sharing among agencies.
*   Evaluate and implement technology standards and best practices.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

*   5+ years of progressive experience in technology leadership.
*   2+ years in senior leadership managing cross-functional teams.
*   Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
*   Analytical problem-solving abilities and data-driven decision-making expertise.
*   Proven record of effective leadership and team collaboration.

Appointment to this position requires obtaining and/or maintaining New York State residency within six months of hiring. For more information and current executive job opportunities, visit [StateJobsNY](https://statejobs.ny.gov/public/vacancyTable.cfm?searchResults=Yes&Keywords=&title=&JurisClassID=&AgID=12&minDate=&maxDate=&employmentType=&grade=&SalMin=).

## Project Positions

**NYS Office of Information Technology Services Project Positions - Open to the Public**

Be a part of IT projects that make a difference for NYS citizens and businesses!

ITS implements technology solutions that provide a dramatically improved experience for customers, expedite business processes, streamline efforts, and provide more opportunities for alternative service delivery. Some of these projects include:

*   Modernization of NYS systems: Criminal Justice, DMV, State Police, Child Welfare, Victim Services, Parks, and Health, to name a few.
*   Consolidation and sharing of NYS GIS tools
*   Standardization of Platforms and Software across NYS
*   Data Analysis and Warehouse Redesign
*   Refining Disaster Recovery and Response systems
*   Standardization of Cyber Security Risk Assessment and Remediation Efforts

Project Assistant, Project Coordinator, and Project Director positions seek specific IT skills required for IT projects throughout the agency. They are open to the public, providing that the candidate meets the minimum qualifications outlined in the vacancy announcement.

Opportunities and related minimum qualifications and salary are posted periodically on StateJobsNY. For ITS specific opportunities open to the public, please visit [StateJobsNY](https://statejobs.ny.gov/public/vacancyTable.cfm?searchResults=Yes&Keywords=&title=&JurisClassID=&AgID=12&minDate=&maxDate=&employmentType=&grade=&SalMin=).

Contact ITS Human Resource Services at[human.resources@its.ny.gov](mailto:human.resources@its.ny.gov)or (518) 473-0398.

## Student Assistant/Intern

**Student Assistant/Intern**

**Are you looking for an exciting and challenging internship experience that allows you to be part of an innovative, growing organization?**We offer undergraduate and graduate employment for students throughout the year--summer, winter, spring and fall!

*   Work on real-life IT projects that fit with your career interests and are solving real business needs, such as: Cybersecurity, Application Development, Mobile Application Design, NYS DMV modernization, E-Licensing, and Health System integrations.
*   Contribute to innovative design and development of new products and services to transform the way state government interacts with citizens, businesses, and visitors.
*   Gain hands-on experience and thrive in an environment targeted towards raising up the next generation of IT leaders.

At ITS, we believe our employees are our most important asset and seek creative, motivated individuals to bring depth and knowledge to our team. We look for innovative solutions that anticipate our partners' needs, extending into the "foreseeable future." We maintain a working environment that empowers our employees to think and act creatively in the best interest of our organization, agencies and citizens we serve. Be a part of projects that can make a difference!

**Competitive Salary**:

*   **Undergraduate: $23.29/hour**
*   **Graduate: $26.12/hour**

**Eligibility Requirements:**

Each opportunity has unique requirements, but all interested candidates must be/have:

*   a US Citizen or foreign national eligible to work in the United States.
*   18 years of age or older.
*   a New York State resident or attending a New York State college, university, or graduate program.
*   a minimum of one (1) year as a student at a degree-granting two or four-year College or University (completion of one year's worth of academic credits over a more extended period of time may qualify part-time students for participation in the Student Intern Program); or a currently enrolled graduate student or accepted in a graduate degree program.
*   a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 2.0.

Preferred degree enrollment and/or skills outlined within the individual opportunities.

**To Apply:**

For additional information on the program, details on specific opportunities, and to apply, please visit [StateJobsNY](https://statejobs.ny.gov/public/vacancyTable.cfm?searchResults=Yes&Keywords=&title=&JurisClassID=&AgID=12&minDate=&maxDate=&employmentType=&grade=&SalMin= "StateJobsNY").

**Questions?**Contact the ITS Diversity and Talent Acquisition team at [internship@its.ny.gov](mailto:internship@its.ny.gov).
